policy: Reviewed official UATs whose single current OSM administrative representation intentionally uses a jurisdiction-specific admin_level different from the ordinary Romanian level-8 UAT convention. These resolutions preserve the OSM representation level and the official SIRUTA legal identity separately; OSM geometry is never promoted to legal geometry.

items.review_conclusion: SIRUTA models BUCUREȘTI as a level-2 municipality under the level-1 MUNICIPIUL BUCUREȘTI record, while current Romanian OSM convention represents the same capital municipality directly as relation 377733 at admin_level=4, with six sector boundaries nested at admin_level=9. This is a structural cross-model level difference, not a missing UAT. Keep the OSM representation at level 4 and the SIRUTA legal identity separately; do not synthesize a duplicate level-8 boundary.
